args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate and failing health checks since the latest deploy. Rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollback verified and rolled out in all regions. Root cause of v2.3.1 failure still under investigation; do not re-deploy v2.3.1 until identified and fixed.

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis**: The latest release, `v2.3.1`, was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- **Rollback**: Rolled checkout-api back to `v2.3.0` — the most recent release that was healthy in production — across all regions. The rollback was verified and is fully rolled out.
- **Incident**: Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback action; the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: The root cause of the `v2.3.1` failure is still unknown — the incident notes that it should not be re-deployed until investigated.
